name: running-man
title: Running Man
description: Provision and manage pools of self-hosted GitHub Actions runners

defaultEnv.label: App secret
defaultEnv.description: Encrypts the GitHub App private key at rest, once you connect GitHub from the Settings page. Not a GitHub credential itself — just a local secret.

defaultEnv.label: Public GitHub App
defaultEnv.description: Allow the GitHub App running-man creates to be installed on organizations you don't own. Leave off unless you're managing runners across multiple orgs.
